question: Quwwat-ul-Islam mosque is situated in:
solution:
The correct answer is __Delhi__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Quwwat-ul-Islam Mosque:-

 
 
• It is in the Qutb Minar enclosure of Delhi.
 
• The initial construction was built by **Qutb-ud-din Aibak.**
 
• It is built of red sandstone, grey quartz, and white marble.
 
• The expansion of the mosque continued after the death of Qutb.
 
• Just to the west of the expanded mosque, Iltutmish built his own tomb, the first to be erected for the Delhi Sultanate.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__Qutb-ud-Din Aibak__

 
• He founded the Slave dynasty as well as the Delhi Sultanate. 
 
• He assumed the title of Sultan and made Lahore his capital.
 
• Aibak patronized the great scholar Hasan Nizami.
 
• He also started the construction of Qutub Minar after the name of a famous Sufi saint Khwaja Qutbuddin Bakthiyar. It was later completed by Iltutmish.
